manifest.name: @local/dsh-proto-annotate-spike
manifest.description: Codex-style element annotations for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. Click a prototype element, describe the change, and send compact annotation chips with DOM context to your agent.
manifest.author: shiyoungwoo

readme.section: DSH 原型批注 · Prototype Annotator
readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) · [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) · [问题反馈](https://github.com/shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator/issues)

[](https://github.com/shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

[](LICENSE)

**在 DSH 里直接点选原型元素、写修改要求，再交给 Agent 修改。** 类似 Codex 的页面批注体验，不用反复截图、画圈或描述“左边第三个按钮”。

支持侧栏浏览器打开的本地开发页面，例如 Vite、React、Vue 开发服务器；无需把项目转换成静态 HTML。输入框和已发送消息都以一个「N 条注释」标签显示，元素选择器和样式等定位信息仍会发送给模型。

- **点选定位**：鼠标悬浮高亮元素，显示尺寸、颜色和字体；点击后输入修改说明。
- **批注入口**：侧栏浏览器地址栏旁、文档预览顶部提供「批注」按钮。也可按 `Option+A`（Windows/Linux 键盘为 `Alt+A`，未验证）。
- **紧凑标签**：多条批注合并成一个「N 条注释」标签。发送前可打开详情、删除单条批注；发送后可只读查看。
- **带上元素信息**：DOM 选择器、标签、短文本、尺寸、样式、页面地址和视口大小随修改要求发送。
- **适配现有工作流**：只把批注加入会话输入框，由你决定何时发送。插件本身不修改项目源文件。
- **无需额外服务**：无运行依赖、无安装构建脚本、无独立采集服务器。

示例操作：打开本地前端 → 点「批注」→ 选中图标 → 输入「这个图标太卡通，改成适合金融平台的线性图标」→ 输入框出现「1 条注释」→ 发送。

| 项目 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3`，macOS | 用户已在实际界面确认点选、加入标签和紧凑消息显示可用 |
| 侧栏 Browser 中的本地前端页面 | 支持，通过 Electron webview 读取 DOM |
| 可访问 DOM 的 HTML 预览 iframe | 支持；跨域和沙箱限制会影响读取 |
| Windows / Linux Desktop | 未验证 |
| 纯 Web、TUI、Headless | 不作为此版本的支持目标 |
| DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5`，macOS | 已检查侧栏文档工具栏插槽和浏览器结构；入口与点选回归测试通过，实际界面未验证 |
| 其他 DSH 版本 | 未验证；包声明范围为 `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0`，不表示整个范围均已验证 |
需要默认 Desktop 提供的 sidebar-right 和 sidebar-browser 宿主插件。插件使用 DSH 当前版本的输入标签、用户消息渲染和侧栏接口。这些接口及工具栏 DOM 结构会随宿主版本变化。宿主升级后需要重新验证；请勿同时安装多个副本。

在 DSH 对话中粘贴以下内容，让 Agent 使用内置插件管理器安装：

```text
请安装 DSH 插件 github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator。
请使用插件管理器 install_bundle，不要手动修改 profile 配置。
```

安装后重新加载 DSH 界面。若没有出现「批注」按钮，退出并重新打开 DSH Desktop。

已配置 `dsh` 命令的用户：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator
```

macOS 应用内置 CLI（不要求将 `dsh` 加到 PATH）：

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator
```

此命令用于默认 `desktop` profile。自定义 profile 请替换名称。插件没有 `prepare` / `postinstall` 构建脚本。尚未发布到 npm，请使用 GitHub 地址或 Release 安装包。
如果从此前的本地试用版迁移，请先在 DSH 插件管理器移除旧的本地链接，再安装 GitHub 版本。为保持已有批注来源一致，本次保留包名 `@local/dsh-proto-annotate-spike`；公开仓库名为 `dsh-prototype-annotator`。

1. 在 DSH Desktop 侧栏浏览器打开你的前端地址，例如 `http://localhost:5173`，或打开可访问 DOM 的 HTML 预览。
2. 点击侧栏浏览器地址栏旁或文档预览顶部的「批注」；快捷键为 `Option+A`。
3. 将鼠标移到元素上查看高亮，点击选中。按 `Esc` 取消点选。
4. 输入修改要求。点击「完成」或按 `Enter` 加入输入框。`Shift+Enter` 换行；中文输入法确认文字不会提交。
5. 输入框出现「N 条注释」。「注释已加入输入框」提示显示 3 秒后自动关闭。继续批注会增加计数。点击标签可查看或删除批注。
6. 根据需要补充普通文字，再发送消息。已发送消息也以紧凑标签显示；点击查看只读详情。

选中元素后直接打开注释框。注释框只使用可见按钮定位，并限制在窗口内；点击框外不会关闭未提交的批注，可用「取消」或 `Esc` 关闭。截图预览在后台加载；截图失败或不返回时仍可输入和提交注释。页面跳转、超时、无法识别元素或未收到选择结果时会显示提示。
从文档预览工具栏进入时，默认使用该预览所属会话的输入框。通过浏览器工具栏或快捷键进入且多个输入框同时存在时，需要在面板中选择目标会话。提交中的输入框不能写入。写入失败时，插件保留批注并显示原因。

GitHub 安装后，重新执行同一安装命令以获取仓库版本，再重启 Desktop。通过 DSH 插件管理器可停用或卸载；命令行卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @local/dsh-proto-annotate-spike
```

标签保存修改要求和元素上下文。元素截图会缩小到最大 `480×320` 的 JPEG，只用于发送前的详情预览，不随批注文本发送给模型。发送后的详情没有截图。

模型收到修改要求、选择器、元素短文本、尺寸、样式、页面 URL 和视口大小。URL 与选中元素的文本会成为会话内容；在含敏感信息的页面上使用前，请检查这些内容。此插件没有额外网络请求或遥测服务，消息仍通过 DSH 当前选择的模型提供方发送。

批注正文以 `<prototype-annotations>` 块保存在会话消息中。插件只改变气泡的显示方式，不删减模型所需的定位信息。停用插件后，会话中仍保留可读的原始文本。

- 按钮未出现：确认使用 Desktop、侧栏已打开页面，并重新加载或重启。`Option+A` 也可开启点选。
- 页面无法点选：跨域 iframe、封闭 Shadow DOM、canvas 绘制内容和嵌套 iframe 不在本版本支持范围内。优先使用侧栏 Browser 打开本地页面。
- 选择器失效：选择器对应点选时的 DOM；页面结构变化后请重新点选。开放 Shadow DOM 使用 ` >>> ` 分隔路径。
- 草稿在重启后能否保留原生引用标签：未验证。
- 部分提示与标签文本目前为中文；插件元数据和主要操作有中英文资源。
- 请勿在不受信任的页面上放宽 iframe 沙箱权限；建议用于你自己的原型和本地开发页面。

无需安装依赖或编译，Node.js `22.19+`：

```sh
npm run check
npm test
npm run test:package
```

回归测试覆盖标签注册、合并、发送上下文、旧消息识别、拒绝写入、静默丢弃、多会话、重复回车、输入法、详情删除、截图挂起、取消竞态和点选异常清理。测试加载真实客户端脚本，宿主服务和 DOM 使用测试替身。打包检查解包实际 tarball，核对入口、资源、清单和无本地路径，并从解包后的脚本执行同一组回归测试。它们不能代替 Desktop 界面验证。

入口文件：`index.js`（Host）、`client.js`（Client）、`cordis.patch.yml`（Bundle），`locale/` 为插件显示资源。GitHub Actions 在 Node.js 22/24 上执行语法、回归和打包检查。

首次公开版本见 [更新记录](CHANGELOG.md)。遇到问题请提交 Issue，附 DSH 版本、系统版本、页面类型和复现步骤；请先遮盖隐私内容。

交互目标参考 Codex 的页面批注体验；本项目是独立实现的第三方 DSH 插件，与 OpenAI 无隶属关系。调研过 [react-grab](https://github.com/aidenybai/react-grab) 等元素定位工具；运行时不依赖这些项目。

**Point at a prototype element inside DSH, describe the change, and send the annotation to your agent.** A Codex-style annotation workflow for local frontends, without manually taking screenshots or describing where a button is.

Open a Vite, React, or Vue development page in the Desktop sidebar browser. Pick an element and write a request. The composer and sent message show a single “N 条注释” chip; the model still receives the DOM context needed to locate the element.

- Hover highlights with element dimensions, color, and font details.
- An annotation button beside the sidebar browser address field and in the document preview toolbar, plus the `Option+A` shortcut (`Alt+A` on Windows/Linux keyboards, unverified).
- Multiple annotations in one compact chip, with a detail view and deletion before sending. Sent annotations are read-only.
- Selector, tag, short text, bounds, styles, page URL, and viewport sent with your request.
- Adds annotations to the draft; you choose when to send. The plugin does not edit source files itself.
- No runtime dependencies, install build scripts, collector service, or telemetry endpoint.
Some labels and messages currently remain in Chinese. Plugin metadata and primary actions have English and Chinese resources.

| Environment | Status |
| --- | --- |
| DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.3` on macOS | Picking, composer chips, and compact sent-message rendering confirmed by the user in the real app |
| Local development pages in the sidebar Browser | Supported through Electron webview DOM access |
| HTML preview iframes with accessible DOM | Supported; origin and sandbox restrictions apply |
| Windows / Linux Desktop | Not verified |
| Standalone Web, TUI, Headless | Outside this release's support target |
| DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.5` on macOS | Sidebar document toolbar slot and browser markup inspected; entry and picking regression tests pass; real UI not verified |
| Other DSH versions | Not verified; the declared range `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0` does not establish tested compatibility across that range |

The default Desktop sidebar-right and sidebar-browser host plugins must be available. This version depends on the host's current reference, transcript, and toolbar APIs. Recheck after a DSH upgrade. Do not install multiple copies.

Ask your DSH agent:

```text
Install the DSH plugin github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator using the built-in plugin manager's install_bundle action. Do not manually edit profile configuration.
```

Or use the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator
```

On macOS, use the bundled CLI if `dsh` is not on PATH:

```sh
"/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add github:shiyoungwoo/dsh-prototype-annotator
```

Replace `desktop` for a custom profile. Reload the UI after installation; if the button is absent, quit and reopen DSH Desktop. The package has no `prepare` or `postinstall` script. It is distributed through GitHub and Release tarballs, not npm.

For migration from the local trial, remove the old local link in the plugin manager before installing the GitHub version. The package retains its original name, `@local/dsh-proto-annotate-spike`, to preserve its existing identity. The public repository is `dsh-prototype-annotator`.

1. Open a local frontend such as `http://localhost:5173` in the DSH sidebar Browser, or an HTML preview with accessible DOM.
2. Click **批注** beside the sidebar browser address field or in the document preview toolbar; the shortcut is `Option+A`.
3. Hover and click an element. Press `Esc` to cancel picking.
4. Write the requested change. Click **完成** or press `Enter`; `Shift+Enter` inserts a newline. IME composition confirmation does not submit.
5. The success notice closes automatically after 3 seconds. Click the composer chip to review or delete individual annotations. More annotations increase the count on the same chip.
6. Add any ordinary message text and send. The sent message also renders as a compact chip with read-only details.

The note editor opens after selection and stays within the window, anchored only to a visible toolbar button. Outside clicks keep unsent notes open; use Cancel or Escape to close. Preview capture runs in the background; a failed or stalled capture does not prevent writing or submitting a note. Navigation, timeout, an unrecognized element, or a missing selection result shows a notice.

The document-preview entry selects its own session's composer by default. With the browser toolbar or shortcut, select the destination in the panel when multiple composers are mounted. A submitting composer cannot receive annotations. Failed insertion keeps the annotation and reports the reason.

To update, repeat the GitHub install command and restart Desktop. Disable or uninstall through DSH's plugin manager, or run:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @local/dsh-proto-annotate-spike
```

The reference stores your note and element context. A screenshot thumbnail, at most `480×320` JPEG, is used only in the pre-send detail view. It is excluded from serialized model text; sent-message details have no screenshot.

Your agent receives the note, selector, tag, short element text, bounds, styles, page URL, and viewport. A `file://` URL can include your local filesystem path. Review these fields before annotating sensitive pages. The plugin makes no additional network requests; the message is sent through your selected DSH model provider.
Messages store readable `<prototype-annotations>` blocks. The plugin compacts their visual rendering without removing model context. Disable it and the original text remains in the conversation.

- No button: use Desktop, open a sidebar page, and reload or restart. Try `Option+A`.
- Cross-origin or nested iframes, closed Shadow DOM, and canvas-drawn content are outside this release's supported selection scope. Prefer opening your own local page in the sidebar Browser.
- Selectors refer to the DOM at selection time. Pick again after structural changes. Open Shadow DOM paths use ` >>> ` separators.
- Native reference persistence across app restarts is unverified.
- Do not relax iframe sandbox settings for untrusted pages. This plugin is intended for your own prototypes and local development pages.

No dependency installation or build is required. Use Node.js `22.19+`:

```sh
npm run check
npm test
npm run test:package
```

The regression tests load the actual client script with host and DOM test doubles. They cover reference registration, merging, serialization, legacy messages, rejected or dropped insertion, multiple composers, double submission, IME, detail deletion, stalled screenshots, cancellation races, and picker error cleanup. The package smoke check unpacks a real tarball, checks entries and resources, and runs those tests against the unpacked client. These checks do not replace a Desktop UI test.

GitHub Actions runs syntax, regression, and package checks on Node.js 22 and 24. The entry files are `index.js` (Host), `client.js` (Client), and `cordis.patch.yml` (Bundle); `locale/` holds metadata resources.

See the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). Include your DSH version, OS, page type, and reproduction steps in an issue; redact private data first.

The interaction goal was inspired by Codex page annotations. This is an independent third-party DSH plugin with no OpenAI affiliation. [react-grab](https://github.com/aidenybai/react-grab) and other element-selection projects were researched; they are not runtime dependencies.
